end.summary:
Practised diversity in language, food, dress, festivals and music across India.
Connected different festival forms through shared seasonal ideas and gratitude.
Explained unity in diversity using examples of festivals and Hindustani/Karnatic music.
Dress example: identified phiran with Kashmir; a phiran/hiran word mix-up appeared and was not fully corrected by the last turn.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that different traditions can share common threads, using harvest festivals and music as examples. Riya gave specific examples such as Pongal dishes, Bihu dance, Lohri bonfires, and different instruments in Hindustani and Karnatic music. There was a phiran/hiran word mix-up; Riya said “phiran” once, but the mix-up appeared again later. At home, ask Riya to sort examples into “shared idea” and “different form,” including one dress example.
